Zone F · field notes

Field Notes

Patterns from the wild — how Ti shows up in daily life.

The Silent Rewrite

A dominant Ti user reads a new paper and says nothing for four days. Then they casually drop a conclusion that reorganizes everything — the lattice rebuilt itself silently.

The Loop

Under stress, INTP Ti pairs with tertiary Si: re-proving old conclusions against old data. The lattice tightens without growing — rigorous, airless, increasingly detached from anything new.

The Inferior Eruption

An ESFJ under stress suddenly becomes rigidly logical, arguing technicalities with an intensity that startles everyone — including themselves. Inferior Ti wakes up brittle and loud.

Ti vs Te

Where Te asks "does it work?" and builds external structures, Ti asks "is it true?" and builds internal coherence. Te trades elegance for speed; Ti trades speed for truth.
